start.welcome:
👋 Welcome! I’m your Italian learning bot. Here’s how it works:

✏️ Send me any Italian word or expression you want to learn or keep in mind.
🤖 I’ll reply with translation + explanation.
💾 You’ll see two buttons:
Save → add the card to your personal study list.
Regenerate → regenerate the explanation if you want another version.
📅 Saved cards will be sent back to you automatically, spaced out for review.  You’ll be asked to rate your familiarity (0–5), and I’ll schedule the next review.

⚠️ Point: you don't receive new FlashCards (reviews) if you don't rate the previous FlashCard or save a new one.
✨ That’s it — just start sending words and build your flashcard deck!

verb.instruction:
✋ Small tip!

To get the conjugation of a verb, type:
/verb <the verb you want>

For example:
/verb andare

💡 In the command menu, if you press and hold the /verb command, it will be added to your message box — then you can simply type the verb after it.

import.usage_guide:
Got a list? Let's add them all! 📦

Just type `/import` followed by your words (on new lines or separated by commas):

Example:
/import
andare a casa
fare colazione
